records.title: Knowledge Accuracy and Response Characteristics of an On-Device Large Language Model in Building Environmental Engineering: a Preliminary Case Study of EXAONE 4.0 1.2B Using ChatGPT-4o as a Cloud Reference
records.reason: The primary abstract is a small Korean-language accuracy/response case study comparing an on-device LLM with ChatGPT-4o; it does not claim inference cost, latency, memory, or serving optimization.

records.title: Meta-Ctrl: Guaranteed Plan Generation by Decoupling Syntactic and Semantic Constraints
records.reason: The saved memory is for robot-specific constrained-decoding machinery, not the LLM weights/KV or general serving path; generalization beyond embodied planning is uncertain.

records.title: Unfolding the Interdisciplinary Complexities of Climate Science: Fuxi-Climate Foundational Model

records.title: Training-Free VLM Personalization via Calibrated Residual Decoding
